name: Completed engagement file review
summary: The quality partner gets a worksheet that tests finished engagement files against the firm's own checklist: each item linked to the engagement letter, workpaper or sign-off that answers it, with any open finding, and the missing evidence listed. The quality partner confirms findings and assigns remediation.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of file inspection in professional services firms, written into a method for testing finished engagement files against a firm's checklist.
